node.title: A rank-two joint anchor sharpens affine polynomial-pair incidence
node.statement: For an affine F-space of degree-<K polynomial pairs of actual dimension r, with A joint agreements on n coordinates, M<=Q^r for Q=(n-K+1)/(A-K+1). If joint evaluation has rank two off e<A coordinates, M<=(n-e)/(A-e)*Q^(r-2). Function-field rank two supplies e<=2K-2, giving the determinant bound whenever A>2K-2. Only the first anchor loses two dimensions; subsequent sections use ordinary joint affine incidence. Exact F7 controls defeat omission of pencil and bad-anchor hypotheses. Pair LIST count only; original-source and slope ownership belong to the consumer.
